title: On the Analyticity of Amoeba Contours
summary: The contour of an amoeba records the critical values of the logarithmic map and forms a fundamental interface between complex algebraic geometry and real-analytic geometry. Building on the known semianalyticity of amoeba contours, we prove the stronger statement that the componentwise exponential image of the contour of any algebraic hypersurface in $(\mathbb C^*)^n$ is semialgebraic.
